versions.runtimeNote: Default runtime (runtimes/JRE, JRE 22, LightThinWrapper). 1.21.1 ships JNA 5.14 (native API 7.0.x), which rejects the default libjnidispatch.so (6.1.2, kept for 1.20.1's JNA 5.12.1), so it loads libjnidispatch704.so (JNA native 7.0.4). Untested on device.
versions.perfModsNote: No VisorQuest-bundled perf mods for 1.21.1: upstream QuestCraft mods.json (QuestCraft-6.0.0) defaultMods for 1.21.1 already installs Sodium, ModernFix, Noisium, Lithium, MoreCulling, BadOptimizations, Ferrite-Core, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling. Chunky/C2ME are 1.20.1-only bundles. Revisit after a device test.

versions.runtimeNote: Java 25 (OpenJDK 25.0.4.1.1 android-arm64 build from MisterEnglishDev/QuestCraftPlus-Pojlib release jre25-android-arm64; no published build source yet, testing only) in runtimes/JRE-25 next to the default runtimes/JRE. Renderer MobileGlues (libmobileglues.so, LGPL-2.1, from QuestCraftPlusPlus/Pojlib QuestCraft-6.0.1). LWJGL: 3.3.3 GLFW shim + QuestCraftPlus+ 26.x patches; lwjgl-vulkan Java classes kept because the 26.x client constructs its Vulkan backend class (OpenGL is tried first). Untested on device. JNA: 26.2 ships JNA 5.17 (native API 7.0.x) so it loads libjnidispatch704.so (JNA native 7.0.4, same binary as QuestCraftPlusPlus/Pojlib QuestCraft-6.0.1); the default libjnidispatch.so (6.1.2) is unchanged for 1.20.1/1.21.1.
versions.perfModsNote: No perf mods for 26.2 yet: upstream QuestCraft mods.json has no 26.2 entry. Fabric API comes from installFabricApi above.
